disposition: No actionable source defect. Raw discarded concern reviewed rather than hidden.
reason: The provider itself identifies a conservative performance miss rather than a correctness hole. Every failed or pending request advances sequence before doing work; unchanged appliedSequence therefore cannot equal the next request sequence minus one. The next same-image request must use native admission; after success it republishes a current mirror and subsequent duplicates may reuse it. Existing invalidator/interleaving/later-refusal tests exercise this ordering. The cached Cur assignment has the prior successful native confirmation plus exact key/generation/scale/live/open-main guards; it deliberately needs no new native assignment. Clearing the mirror on failure would not strengthen this sequence guard.
